tap.say: Ziinzibaakwadwaaboo drips from the cut into your {bucket} until it is full.
tap.again: This ininaatig has given its sap today. Try another tree.
tap.none: You need an empty biskitenaagan or an akik (pail) to catch the sap.
tap.off: The sap is not running. It runs in the spring, in the days before the maples bud.
tap.cold: The day never thawed: the sap is not running today.
tap.warm: The night did not freeze: the sap is not running today.

peel.say: You cut round the trunk and ease off a sheet of wiigwaas. The birch will heal by next year.
peel.again: This birch has given its wiigwaas this year. Leave it to heal and find another.
peel.noTool: You need a tomahawk or an axe to cut the wiigwaas (birch bark) from the tree.

S.name: Biiwaanag (flint)
S.say: You pry a nodule of biiwaanag (flint) out of the chalky bank.

V.name: Obsidian
V.say: You work a piece of black obsidian loose from the bank. Its broken edge is sharper than any knife.

peel.noTool: You need a tomahawk or an axe to cut the bark from the miskwaabiimizh (red willow).
peel.say: You shave the red outer bark from a stem of miskwaabiimizh (red willow). It will grow back by tomorrow.
peel.again: This miskwaabiimizh (red willow) has given its bark today. Try another clump, or come back tomorrow.

effects.note: effect library (core.js EFFECTS); item JSON: Effect, Effect ticks, Effect chance (%), Effect damage. Unknown effects are ignored.

fireMix.say: You toast the miskwaabiimizh (red willow) bark over the fire and rub it fine with the asemaa (tobacco): three pinches of apaakozigan (kinnikinnick).
You simmer the potatoes, onions and shrimp with the sea salt into a pirate's stew. It smells like something other than fish.

tobacco.say: You set down a pinch of asemaa (tobacco) and give thanks before you take anything from here. The ground here is blessed for you today.

snare.say: You bend a sapling, tie the noose of the nagwaagan (snare) across a waabooz (rabbit) run and leave it.
snare.none: There are no waabooz (rabbit) runs here. Set the nagwaagan (snare) where the rabbits are.
snare.empty: The nagwaagan (snare) is still empty. Leave it a while and come back.
snare.caught: There is a {prey} in your nagwaagan (snare).

retaliate.note: a monster hit in the last `ticks` keeps its attacker as target across zone borders and up to `beyond` tiles past its leash (the operator)

respawn.note: a dead monster comes back when its zone has been empty this long (50 ticks = 30 s) and someone enters, or after deadTicks (2000 = 20 min) at its post when no player stands within 8 tiles of it

death.note: everything carried and worn drops where you die; what rules.persist keeps (Gold, stones, magical, worth 100+) stays until taken, the rest lasts pileTicks (1000 = 10 minutes)

persist.note: a drop lies where it fell until someone takes it when it is Gold, a teleport stone or rune stone, magical, or worth minValue GOLD or more (value x how many); everything else despawns. The @ashvale Bank holds persisted drops and shows them to every player

ziibiing.name: Ziibiing
ziibiing.offerHint: Before you take from the land, set down a little asemaa (tobacco) and give thanks: Biindaakoojige (offer tobacco) from your bag. The land gives more to those who ask.
ziibiing.first: Ningashi, your mother, sits by the fire. Tap her to change your hair and clothes.
help: You open your eyes by the fire in your mother's wigwam. Ningashi sees to your hair and clothes. When you are ready, go and see Mishoomis in his wigwam.
Ziibiing means "at the river". The people of the village each know their own part of the world: the canoe, the fish, the rice, the plants, the sky, the drum. Right-click one and talk.
The makak by the village fire holds everything you own in your arcade wallet.
Eat when your hitpoints run low.

creator.note: 2026-10-08: everyday Anishinaabe wear, never medieval clothing; long hair; a man may go bare-chested; dance regalia is earned later. A list may be split by body.

ziibiing.wakeSay: You wake by the fire in your mother's wigwam.
ziibiing.noFire: You need biiwaanag (flint) to light a fire. Mishoomis knows where it lies along the riverbank.

yard.note: 2026-10-04: chickens wherever there are buildings - n birds per `per` buildings, by a building, at most max per town

gift_of_angels.name: the Gift of Angels
gift_of_angels.desc: Iria's blessing is on you now: the Ring of Angels rests ten minutes between saves instead of an hour.

vorth_gate.name: Pike's latch
vorth_gate.desc: Pike has opened the compound gate. You may enter and leave.

vorth_bag.name: Edric's bag
vorth_bag.desc: You searched the bones in the Spider Cave.

cave_antidote.name: The cave crate
cave_antidote.desc: You already took the antidote hidden in the crate at the mouth of the Spider Cave.

vorth_spoke.name: Edric's last word
vorth_spoke.desc: Edric's shade has said his piece and gone.

replant.name: Replanting
replant.desc: You can set a sapling in any stump, anywhere a tree used to stand. The tree grows back.

spidercrown.name: the Spider Queen's Crown
spidercrown.desc: You took the Spider Queen's crown from her. She gives it to each adventurer once.

heart_balance_tuned.name: the balance seal
heart_balance_tuned.desc: The prayer seal below the keep is balanced.

heart_war_cleared.name: the war trial
heart_war_cleared.desc: The final guardian wave has fallen.

heart_iron_tuned.name: the iron root seal
heart_iron_tuned.desc: The first Dragon Heart chamber is tuned.

dragon_heart_reset.name: the restored Dragon Heart
dragon_heart_reset.desc: The power beneath the ruined keep is steady again.

heart_prayer_ranged.name: the verdant prayer rune
heart_prayer_ranged.desc: You faced the chamber's ranged arrow test.

heart_echo_cleared.name: the echo trial
heart_echo_cleared.desc: The first guardian wave has fallen.

heart_prayer_melee.name: the crimson prayer rune
heart_prayer_melee.desc: You faced the chamber's melee rock test.

heart_prayer_magic.name: the azure prayer rune
heart_prayer_magic.desc: You faced the chamber's magic bolt test.

seer_scroll.name: the hollow oak's scroll
seer_scroll.desc: You took Hollin's scroll from the hollow oak.

fivestones_1.name: the Hawk stone
fivestones_1.desc: The first of the Fivestones is awake.

fivestones_2.name: the Hound stone
fivestones_2.desc: The second of the Fivestones is awake.

fivestones_3.name: the Hart stone
fivestones_3.desc: The third of the Fivestones is awake.

fivestones_4.name: the Hare stone
fivestones_4.desc: The fourth of the Fivestones is awake.

stones_open.name: the red ring
stones_open.desc: The Fivestones are awake; their ring leads to Emberfall.

seer_freed.name: Hollin's freedom
seer_freed.desc: You freed Old Hollin from the gibbet in Emberfall.

maiden_slain.name: the Thornwatch's thanks
maiden_slain.desc: You put Maelis, Maiden of Thorns, back in the ground. The road east is open.

farming.note: a block is a minute of the game's clock (Dogecoin's block time); the clock keeps running while you are away, so crops grow offline

seeds.note: 1 kill in `chance` drops a seed; which one by weight x (1 + beast level / 10) ^ (crop level / boost) among the crops of level <= 2 x the beast's level + 3 - so the strong drop the rare seeds more often, and a higher seed is always rarer than a lower one off the same beast; rolled on dice of their own (core.js FARMING), never the world's

field.note: a step onto open grass outside the towns finds a seed 1 time in `chance` (about one every few minutes of walking), of a crop no more than `over` levels above your Farming

strays.note: 2026-10-19: cats in every town (src/world.js strays) - one per `per` buildings, at most max, or the town's own number

tutorial.note: a new character of this home starts at spawn with the quest begun, and is brought back if they stray off the island before the quest is done; done, they wake at the home's own spawn (src/core.js TUTORIAL)
